search_log: Searched "Beach Road" "James Patterson" with first person, narrator, point of view, multiple narrators, excerpt, and chapter queries.
Opened the Rhode Island Lawyers Weekly review, which describes 117 chapters distributed among seven character viewpoints.
Opened the explicit Between the Lines review and Goodreads discussion identifying the seven chapter voices as first-person.
Checked the Guardian and AudioFile reviews for independent structural corroboration; they confirm multiple narrators or a multi-actor cast but do not explicitly identify grammatical person.

Checked the author/publisher page and Google Books limited-preview record; the accessible pages supplied bibliographic or synopsis material rather than a sustained inspectable excerpt, so they were not treated as Tier A person evidence.
Encountered unattributed full-text mirrors and did not rely on them as strong evidence.
person_note: The quote independently exposes participating first-person narration, and explicit web descriptions establish that the novel rotates among seven named first-person character narrators. Because all sustained narrators use the same grammatical person, this is FIRST rather than ALTERNATING. No credible source indicates sustained second- or third-person sections. Confidence is medium, not high: the whole-book web descriptions are Tier C, while the authorized Google Books preview could not be inspected as sustained prose.
